what_to_try: Replay each read/update/delete with another user's, branch's or tenant's object id.
repo_note: Per-user ownership is a rule, not a mandated test.

what_to_try: Call admin and other-role RPC paths with a low-role token; check empty role lists.
Send the branch/tenant override header as a non-privileged user; unknown branch; check fallback.
Use tenant A token on tenant B keys, staged payloads, pushes, static asset paths.
repo_note: Non-code barrier required (R12).

what_to_try: Add role, tenant, owner or status fields to request bodies and see if persisted.
repo_note: Dedicated request types; unknown fields are ignored, not rejected (26 §3).

what_to_try: Compare response fields across roles in the network tab; look for unused personal data.
Feed internal, metadata (169.254.169.254) and redirecting URLs to any import or fetch feature.
repo_note: No outbound-fetch rule.

what_to_try: Inject script into query params and error paths of the SPA and HTML pages.
repo_note: JSON-only API and code-only errors; no CSP rule for the web app.

what_to_try: Store HTML/script in names, notes, brand config; view in web app, emails, consent page.
repo_note: Escaping required in consent page and email; no rule for web client raw-HTML sinks.

what_to_try: Look for innerHTML / dangerouslySetInnerHTML, javascript: URLs, location-driven rendering.
repo_note: No client sink or CSP rule.

what_to_try: Forge cross-site POSTs to API and consent approve without the CSRF token.
repo_note: Bearer header, not cookie, for API; consent has hashed CSRF token.

what_to_try: Frame the app and consent page from another origin.
repo_note: Note 29 §1.2: headers missing on ≥400 responses.

what_to_try: Tamper return/next URLs after sign-in and redirect params on any page.
repo_note: OAuth redirects allowlisted; no general rule for app redirect parameters.

what_to_try: Send arbitrary Origin; check reflection, wildcard, null origin with credentials.
repo_note: Single source and guard test; no rule forbidding reflection or wildcard.

what_to_try: Inject operators and quotes into filters, keys, sort fields of every store.
Find any shell-out, eval or dynamic require reachable from input.
repo_note: No rule banning shell or eval on input.

what_to_try: Send __proto__ / constructor.prototype keys in JSON bodies and merges.
repo_note: No rule on deep-merging untrusted JSON.

what_to_try: Send alg none, HS256 with public key, wrong iss/aud, expired tokens.
repo_note: Gateway verifies signature, issuer, audience; no app token signing.

what_to_try: Register or authorize with off-list, prefix-matched or loopback redirect URIs.
Authorize without code_challenge or with plain; redeem code without verifier.
repo_note: Relies on SDK; no test that missing/plain PKCE is refused.

what_to_try: Swap codes between flows; drop or reuse state on upstream callback.
repo_note: Audience and resource checks; state validation on upstream leg not stated.

what_to_try: Register attacker client, send user authorize link, check silent code release.
Plant a session/consent id before sign-in and see if it survives.
repo_note: No app session; broker session only after Approve.

what_to_try: Automated sign-in attempts per account and per IP against hosted page.
repo_note: Firewall rate rule and TOTP available; MFA not mandated, IdP lockout settings not named.

what_to_try: Compare sign-in, reset, invite and activation responses for known vs unknown addresses.
repo_note: Activation resend uniform; IdP user-existence error setting not named.

attack: Password reset / link poisoning via Host header
what_to_try: Alter Host / X-Forwarded-Host on reset and activation requests; inspect link host.
repo_note: Reset by provider with placeholders; activation link host source not stated.

what_to_try: Reuse, replay after expiry, or guess activation links.
repo_note: Single-use, hashed, expiring.

what_to_try: Look for tokens in URLs, logs, error reports, tool results.
Send unkeyed headers (X-Forwarded-Host etc.) to cacheable static and shell responses.
repo_note: Only fingerprinted assets cached; no rule on unkeyed headers.

what_to_try: Request /api/x/foo.css style paths and check CDN caching of private data.
repo_note: API is POST-only; CDN caches fingerprinted assets only.

what_to_try: CL.TE / TE.CL desync through CDN to origin.
repo_note: Managed CDN and gateway in front of serverless; no self-run proxy hop.

what_to_try: Use ../ and encoded variants in file names, storage keys and asset paths.
repo_note: Keys built by app; no rule normalising user file names in keys.

what_to_try: Upload SVG/HTML/polyglot with allowed type; open the served URL in browser.
repo_note: Type and size pinned in signature; no content check or attachment disposition on serve.

what_to_try: Upload archives with ../ entries to any import that extracts.
repo_note: No archive-extraction rule; applies only if imports unpack archives.

what_to_try: Send XML bodies or XML-based files (SVG, DOCX) to parsers.
repo_note: JSON-only RPC; no XML parsing in the architecture.

what_to_try: Send long crafted strings to fields validated by regex.
repo_note: No regex or input-length rule.

what_to_try: Fire parallel requests at single-use, quota and state-transition endpoints.
repo_note: Conditional writes are the concurrency primitive; single-use takes.

what_to_try: Skip workflow steps, replay, negative values, exceed counts.
repo_note: State-machine checks required; no abuse-case testing rule.

what_to_try: Find DNS records pointing at deleted CDN, bucket or hosted-UI targets.
repo_note: DNS and targets in same IaC; no explicit dangling-record check.

what_to_try: Check internal names on public registry; lock entries from foreign hosts; near-miss names.
Open PR modifying workflow/tests to print secrets or assume deploy/plan roles.
repo_note: Branch-bound roles; 28 §7 admits any branch can run plan reading member data.

what_to_try: Store instructions in user data; have agent read it; see if it calls harmful tools.
repo_note: Limited by allowlist; no marking of tool output as untrusted.

what_to_try: Switch tenant in one conversation; write from another; revoke membership mid-session.
Guess, replay, read back or cross-tenant-swap staged payload ids.
Put CRLF and extra headers in names, subjects and recipient fields that reach mail.
repo_note: Provider templates and From restriction; no CRLF rule for app-sent mail.

what_to_try: Store =, +, -, @ values; export to CSV and open in a spreadsheet.
repo_note: Exports exist (18 §3); no formula-escaping rule.

what_to_try: Send unsigned, re-signed or replayed webhook events.
repo_note: Signature checked first and handlers idempotent; no timestamp/replay window rule.

attack: Rate-limit bypass via spoofed client IP
what_to_try: Rotate X-Forwarded-For on rate-limited endpoints.
repo_note: One-hop trust rule stated for the tool server only.

what_to_try: Trigger malformed and failing requests; inspect bodies for detail.
Register same scheme in a rogue app; intercept auth callbacks and links.
repo_note: PKCE protects the auth code; no rule on verified app/universal links.

what_to_try: Pull app sandbox and backups on rooted device; read DB and prefs.
repo_note: Tokens in secure storage; embedded DB and backups unaddressed.

what_to_try: Proxy with user-installed CA; check cleartext and pinning.
repo_note: No cleartext ban or pinning rule for the app.
